result.title: Same Function, Different Mechanism: Implementation-Local Geometry Beyond Accuracy
result.comment: 16 pages. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Includes technical appendices and ancillary reproduction code
result.summary: Two models can make exactly the same predictions yet respond differently when their implementations are perturbed. A lookup table can change one case independently; a shared rule couples changes across cases. We compare these mechanisms through an implementation chart: a specified local family of logit perturbations around a fixed predictive distribution. Our main result counts the independent prediction changes allowed by exact finite-group sharing: the active dimension is the number of input-output orbits minus the number of input orbits. For softened modular addition, lookup and shared cyclic charts therefore have ranks $p^2(p-1)$ and $p-1$ despite identical predictions. The classical Fisher pullback connects these dimensions to local KL curvature; mechanism-preserving reparameterizations leave the rank unchanged. We also bound the spectral tail under approximate sharing and separate quadratic rank from higher-order learning coefficients. Trained modular-addition models verify that chart rank is measurable, while controlled compiled transformers distinguish compiler-supported intermediate charts from matched alternatives. Negative controls show where this discrimination fails. The framework evaluates specified mechanism hypotheses; it does not infer a unique mechanism from predictions or predict training dynamics.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「实现图」框架，用固定预测分布附近的局部 logit 扰动族比较机制：精确有限群共享下可独立改变预测的维数等于输入-输出轨道数减输入轨道数，并以 Fisher 拉回联系局部 KL 曲率，在模块加法与编译 Transformer 上验证其可测性。
AI.relevance_reason: 这与 LVR 中区分「同一答案、不同内部机制」及估计 latent 状态有效维度的需求相关；其秩与曲率指标可能可供核查 latent 推理是否具有共享耦合结构，但无视觉或多模态实验，迁移性待核查。
